> Change instructions and regenerate outputs

1. Edit .promptscript source fragments, never generated AGENTS.md,
   CLAUDE.md, or .factory content.

2. Run promptscript check and promptscript validate --strict.
3. Run promptscript compile.
4. Run promptscript diff and inspect generated output.
5. Run make check and workflow validation.
